metadata.title: LECONS DE CHIMIE ÉLÉMENTAIRE
metadata.title_complement: appliquées aux arts industriels et faites aux ouvriers du XIIe arrondissement

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The main title "CHIMIE ÉLÉMENTAIRE" features extreme contrast between thick vertical stems and very thin horizontal hairlines, characteristic of the "Fat Face" style popular in the early 19th century for advertising and titles. It incorporates heavy, block-like serifs.
